thread:
maya: Hey — escalation from a customer: embeddings endpoint started returning intermittent 400s with 'dimension mismatch' and we saw tail latency spikes around the same time. Happened ~10:42 PST.
ajay: Can you paste the exact error and a minimal request example?
maya: Error from infra logs:
```
ERROR embed-service shard=3 request_id=abc123 status=400 msg="dimension mismatch: expected 1536 got 768"
WARN batch-coalescer batch_id=452 waiting=42ms final_size=58 tail_latency=420ms
```
Request body (redacted):
```
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  "model": "embed-large-v2",
  "input": ["...some short text..."],
  "user": "acme-service"
}
```
maya: Customers are not changing models. They claim they only hit embed-large-v2. No auth/billing errors reported by them.
liam: Two quick hypotheses: 1) dynamic batching coalesced requests for different model variants (e.g., embed-small) leading to mixed-dim inputs making downstream verifier reject the batch; 2) some clients sending precomputed vectors (wrong shape) or using an older SDK that sets model override.
nora: Can we see the routing logs for that window? specifically model param seen on ingress and batch composition info.
maya: Pasted small snippet from router trace:
```
INGRESS req=abc123 model=embed-large-v2 client_id=acme-service
INGRESS req=abc124 model=embed-small-v1 client_id=acme-service
COALESCE batch_id=452 members=[abc120..abc179] models=[embed-large-v2,embed-small-v1]
```
ajay: Yup that's the smoking gun — coalescer mixed variants. Why didn't validator drop the incompatible requests earlier?
liam: Currently validation runs inside the shard after coalescing to avoid per-request overhead; validator sees final batch and fails on mixed dims causing 400s for the whole batch. That also explains tail latency — retries + backpressure.
maya: Immediate mitigation options?
liam: 1) Short-term hotfix: change coalescer to group by `model` key before forming batches (fast patch to routing config). 2) Quick config knob: reduce max_batch_size from 64 -> 16 to reduce chance of mixed batches. 3) Reject cross-variant coalescing at ingress (returns 422 for incompatible model params) — safer.
nora: Deploy-bot created rollout candidate with group-by-model change to coalescer. @deploy-bot can you link the PR?
deploy-bot: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/coalescer#789 — group-by-model + unit tests. Canary target: embedders-prod us-west-2.
ajay: For customer support: ask the customer to check SDK version and any explicit model override in their calls. Also check if any of their services are still calling embed-small-v1 accidentally.
maya: I asked the customer for a short curl repro and they've sent a minimal script that sets model=embed-small-v1 in one microservice. They had a rollout that mixed two clients — bad rollout.
liam: Longer-term: we should add a validator at the coalescer level that checks model id consistency before forming a batch (cheap hash compare). Also add metric 'coalesced_mixed_model_count' + alert when >0.
nora: Also consider making model variant incompatible -> never coalesce unless models are bit-for-bit identical or share embedding dims. That will prevent silent mismatches.
ajay: Any auth/billing angle? maybe some requests are hitting fallback model due to token tier routing and model variants differ?
maya: Verified token -> tier mapping was stable during incident, no billing errors.
liam: Repro steps for eng to validate fix:
1) Spin up local coalescer with max_batch_size=64 and grouping disabled.
2) Fire 200 concurrent requests where 30% use model embed-small-v1 and 70% embed-large-v2 from same client id.
3) Observe mixed batches and 400s.
4) Apply patch (group-by-model) and re-run; expect no 400s and tail latency drop <100ms.

ajay: I'll own the canary and customer comms. Maya -> give me the customer contact and their repro curl. I'll ask them to pause the rollout.
maya: Sent details to @ajay in DMs. Customer paused their internal rollout.
nora: Created ticket INF-1123 to track followups: add coalescer-level validation, add metrics, add canary run checklist.
liam: Postmortem action items:
- [ ] coalescer: group-by-model default (PR 789) (owner: liam)
- [ ] add coalescer validation + metric (owner: nora)
- [ ] add SDK compatibility check docs for customers (owner: maya)
- [ ] short-term config knob publish: max_batch_size -> 16 for embedders-prod if we see recurrence (owner: ajay)

maya: Customer happy for now; latency normalized after they paused rollout and we canaryed patch. Closing escalation unless we see recurrence. :thumbsup:
